description: Source code for QuicChromiumPacketReader class handling UDP packet reading, including support for multiple packet reads on specific platforms, with detailed processing and error handling.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
classes.description: Handles reading UDP packets, supports multiple packet reads, manages read buffers, and communicates with a visitor for packet processing and error reporting.

methods.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket, clock, visitor, read buffer, and logging.

methods.name: StartReadingMultiplePackets
methods.description: Attempts to read multiple packets if platform supports it, with fallback to single packet reading.

methods.name: ProcessMultiplePacketReadResult
methods.description: Processes results from multiple packet read attempts, handles errors, and notifies visitor.

methods.name: OnReadMultiplePacketComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of multiple packet read, triggers re-reading if successful.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins reading packets, supports multiple packet reading on specific platforms, falls back to single read.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes result of a single read, handles errors, constructs packet, and notifies visitor.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a single read, triggers next read if successful.
